conditions: Kilo Terms §§1(A) and 5(C)(i) contemplate use of the Gateway API to make Services available through Your Service to end users, but all end users must comply with Kilo Terms and usage limits; treat paid separately branded resale as conditional until its precise scope is reviewed.

Do not treat the limited, non-transferable, non-sublicensable license or end-user API carve-out as a reseller sublicense or an unconditional resale grant; obtain and review any applicable written Enterprise Agreement before widening the scope.

Do not use Kilo Pass subscription credits for downstream sale unless written terms expressly allow it; public tier page does not specify reseller/wholesale terms. Prefer no plan assumption in any future review.

For every model, capture actual serving provider, model publisher/license, exact model/provider terms, and whether the route is Kilo-operated or BYOK; a Kilo catalog ID/provider label does not settle those rights.
Record current quote and route availability separately from public price/catalog data; trust, customer price, and rule approval remain separate human decisions.
plan_rules.clause: Kilo Terms §§1(A), 3(B), 5(A), 5(C)(i), and 5(E); Kilo Gateway product/pricing page
plan_rules.reason: Official terms expressly contemplate end-user access through a service using the Gateway API, while retaining a limited non-sublicensable license and downstream compliance duties. This supports a conditional candidate, not an established right to resell any model, plan credits, or upstream provider service.
